dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale fringes are visible along the edges of the folded secondaries and tertials, creating a distinct repetitive scalloped boundary against the darker inner feather pigmentation.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The transition from the uniform brown crown to the patterned mantle is non-linear and gradual, defined by the emergence of the dark feather centers rather than a sharp boundary line.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast dark facial mask is visible, extending from the base of the bill through the ocular region.
